# csv/source

A built-in source adapter for person records. It publishes no per-record estimate, so plan prints `?`, and it demands no credential.

## Manifest

| Key | Value |
|---|---|
| id | `csv/source` |
| version | 1 |
| role | source |
| entity type | person |
| credentials | none |
| cost estimate per record | not published |

## Needs

Nothing. A source starts a run, so no record precedes it.

## Provides

None declared. What it writes depends on its `with:` config, and plan reports the fields as the step resolves them.

## Config keys

The keys `with:` accepts. Plan rejects any other key.

| Key | Type | Required | What it sets |
|---|---|---|---|
| `columns` | object |  | Ingress mapping (ADR-018): canonical field name → CSV header as written. Headers already matching canonical names auto-map; unmapped non-canonical headers become csv.\<normalized_header\>. |
| `entity_type` | one of person, company |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  |  |
| `path` | string | yes | CSV file to read; header row names the fields |

## Example

From [Your CSV](/start/my-csv):

```yaml
source:
  use: csv/source
  with:
    path: contacts.csv
    columns:
      full_name: Full Name
      email: Email
      title: Title
      company_domain: Company Website
```
